sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The DecayModes class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for comprehensive analysis of top quark decay modes in Monte Carlo 16 (MC16) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, extending its functionalities to extract and organize detailed information about resonant and spectator top quark decays, including their modes, charges, PDG IDs, and lepton statistics. This class facilitates a high-performance extraction and structuring of decay mode data for further physics analysis.

sect1.title: The DecayModes Class
sect1.para: DecayModes is a cdef class, indicating its implementation as a Cython extension type. It inherits from SelectionTemplate, thereby gaining all the base functionalities for event selection, ROOT file interpretation, and weight management. Its primary role is to encapsulate a C++ decaymodes object, which likely contains the logic for identifying and categorizing top quark decay products.

listitem.para: __cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent, called during object allocation. It initializes a new C++ decaymodes object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to a decaymodes* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): The Cython "destructor" equivalent, called upon object deallocation. It deallocates the C++ decaymodes object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): This method is responsible for converting the C++ data structures within the underlying decaymodes object into Python dictionaries and lists, making them accessible as properties of the DecayModes instance.
self.res_top_modes: Populated from self.tt.res_top_modes (resonant top decay modes).
self.res_top_charges: Populated from self.tt.res_top_charges (resonant top charges).
self.res_top_pdgid: Populated from self.tt.res_top_pdgid (resonant top PDG IDs).
self.spec_top_modes: Populated from self.tt.spec_top_modes (spectator top decay modes).
self.spec_top_charges: Populated from self.tt.spec_top_charges (spectator top charges).
self.spec_top_pdgid: Populated from self.tt.spec_top_pdgid (spectator top PDG IDs).
self.all_pdgid: Populated from self.tt.all_pdgid (all PDG IDs encountered).
self.signal_region: Populated from self.tt.signal_region (information about the signal region).
self.lepton_statistics: Populated from self.tt.lepton_statistics (statistics related to leptons).
self.ntops: Populated from self.tt.ntops (number of top quarks).

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The DecayModes class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class DecayModes: Declares DecayModes as a Cython extension type.
cdef decaymodes *tt: A C++ pointer to a decaymodes object, which is the specialized C++ implementation for decay mode analysis.
self.ptr = new decaymodes(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <decaymodes*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing DecayModes to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific decaymodes data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which DecayModes inherits.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport *: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures, specifically as_dict and as_basic_dict.
